messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Maya (SRE on-call). Alert: sharp increase in 429s from hosted inference API (route /v1/generate). Canary deploy at 09:10 suspected. Please acknowledge and triage.
Maya (SRE on-call): acknowledging — looking now. Paging Devin (Platform) for deploy context.
Devin (Platform): on it. saw canary rollout for rl-service v2.4.1 at 09:08. Canary traffic 5%. Logs show rate-limiter config reloaded with new policy 'rl-v2-cfg' at 09:09.
Lia (Support): we have 6 live tickets and 4 chats in the queue, customers reporting 429s and "quota exceeded" while they were well under expected usage. CC Amir.
Amir (Customer Success): flagged two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, FinSys) experiencing sustained failures. They're on Dedicated capacity but requests are hitting hosted API frontends.
Maya (SRE on-call): ok that's bad. hypothesis: new canary mistakenly dropped exemptions for Dedicated/reserved tokens. Can you confirm whether exemptions were part of rl-v2-cfg? Devin?
Devin (Platform): checking config diff... pasting snippet:
```
- exempt_accounts: ["dedicated-.*", "system:infra-token"]
+ exempt_accounts: []
```
Devin (Platform): wow — defaults got clobbered in template. That would remove all exemptions.
Tom (Product): that explains customer reports. Canary should not touch exemptions. We need an immediate mitigation: toggle kill-switch for feature flag or rollback canary. Which is faster?
Maya (SRE on-call): kill-switch for rl-service to revert to previous config would be quickest. I can flip feature flag in Console if someone gives me flag name.
Devin (Platform): flag is `rl-config-v2-active`. Setting to false will make router serve pre-v2 config.
Maya (SRE on-call): doing it now.
Maya (SRE on-call): /api/flags/toggle rl-config-v2-active false
```
Success: rl-config-v2-active -> false (toggled by Maya)
```
Maya (SRE on-call): metrics: 429 rate dropping in 30s. dashboard shows error-rate from 18% -> 3% on canary nodes.
deploy-bot: Rollout watcher: canary halt recommended. Canary traffic frozen at 5%. Automatic rollback not triggered (policy requires 3m).
Lia (Support): confirming with customers — AcmeCorp reports requests resumed within last minute. :thumbsup:
Amir (Customer Success): notifying account teams and opening bridge with AcmeCorp to explain.
Devin (Platform): while flag toggle buys time we still need to fix template. Root cause: the templating step in deploy pipeline replaced `exempt_accounts` with an empty list when a variable was unset. We'll push a hotfix to the rollout pipeline.
Maya (SRE on-call): I'll take a quick canary rollback to be safe. Initiating rollback to v2.4.0 for canary nodes.
Devin (Platform): /deploy rollback rl-service --to v2.4.0 --scope canary
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started for rl-service canary -> target v2.4.0. 3 nodes rolling sequentially.
```
Maya (SRE on-call): watching logs. 429s on canary nodes down to normal. Overall 5xx unchanged.
Tom (Product): thanks. do we have an estimate of how many customers affected and for how long?
Lia (Support): tally from tickets/chats: 12 customers reached out directly, window ~09:08–09:13 (5 min), two enterprise accounts had degraded throughput briefly. No data exfil/latency SLOs breached.
Amir (Customer Success): AcmeCorp and FinSys both saw retry loops but no lasting data loss. I've scheduled follow-ups.
Maya (SRE on-call): handoff: I'm going to stabilize infra and then hand to Devin for postmortem. Devin will own the rollback PR and pipeline fix.
Devin (Platform): acknowledged. I'll open a hotfix PR to restore templating default and add unit tests to prevent empty exemptions. Also will add a guard to the deploy pipeline to fail if exemptions list is empty for rl-service.
Tom (Product): we should also consider adding a safe-mode in Console to auto-preserve exemptions on config upgrades. Filed a product ticket.
Maya (SRE on-call): quick runbook notes added in channel: when 429 spike after RL deploy -> check `exempt_accounts` in config, toggle `rl-config-v2-active` if present, rollback canary.
Maya (SRE on-call): on-call handoff to Devin at 09:48 — I'm signing off from active page.
Devin (Platform): taking over incident follow-ups. I'll coordinate PR, add pipeline guard, and schedule a postmortem with all stakeholders.
Lia (Support): closing impacted tickets as resolved, will re-open if customers report further issues.
Amir (Customer Success): will send templated incident note to impacted customers and include mitigation timeline.
Tom (Product): action items please: 1) Devin: pipeline hotfix + guard (P0) 2) QA: integration test for exemptions in staging (P1) 3) SRE: update runbook to include flag name and mitigation steps (P1) 4) Product: Console safe-mode proposal (P2).
Devin (Platform): noted. I'll target an emergency patch today and include link to PR in follow-up.
Maya (SRE on-call): final note: root cause likely templating bug introduced in deploy-helper 1.9. Will confirm in postmortem. Good job getting kill-switch live quickly. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Incident closed for active paging. Manual follow-up required.
Tom (Product): thanks team. We'll schedule a blameless postmortem and timeline. Closing thread when PRs and customer comms are done.
